content: The official Codex app-server documents account/rateLimits/read with primary and secondary quota windows, usedPercent, windowDurationMins, resetsAt, reached type, optional monthly limits, spend-control status, and earned-reset metadata. Sparse update notifications must be merged or followed by a fresh read; null and empty values have distinct meanings. The keypad should display read-only normalized host snapshots and explicit unavailable/stale state.
